topics.label: Introduction and Course Overview
topics.groupedBecause: It welcomes the students, sets out the core learning outcomes for the cancer biology module, and outlines the themes of the upcoming lecture series.

topics.label: Cellular, Genetic, and Developmental Basis of Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: They introduce the core biological concept of cancer as a progressive failure of genetic regulation, cellular differentiation, and tissue architecture, alongside experimental models used to study it.

topics.label: Tumor Invasion, Metastasis, and Malignant Progression
topics.groupedBecause: They detail the histological features, biological mechanisms, and diagnostic criteria of tumor invasion and metastasis, illustrated through colorectal cancer progression.

topics.label: Neoplasm Classification, Nomenclature, and Pathological Impact
topics.groupedBecause: They outline the diagnostic naming conventions, behavioral risks, and physiological mechanisms through which benign and malignant tumors cause pathology and mortality in patients.

topics.label: Cancer Incidence Across Tissues and Species
topics.groupedBecause: They examine the epidemiological patterns and incidence of tumors across different human organ systems and throughout the animal kingdom.

topics.label: Principles and Practice of Cancer Screening
topics.groupedBecause: They discuss the clinical rationale, methodologies, and varying effectiveness of screening programs for early cancer detection across different organs.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Practical Briefing
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the session by reviewing the learning outcomes and providing housekeeping details for subsequent practicals and lectures.
